market_question: Will the US acquire part of Greenland in 2026?
reasoning: The probability that the US acquires part of Greenland by end‑2026 is very low, around 1.5 %. No serious negotiations are underway; Denmark and Greenland have repeatedly rejected such ideas. Even under a Trump presidency the required sovereign transfer or exclusive‑jurisdiction deal lacks political feasibility.
evidence_points: All previous US overtures (1946, 2019) were firmly rejected by Denmark and Greenland.
Greenlandic and Danish leaders have publicly stated the territory is not for sale.
No binding agreement or legislative action is currently pending or realistically plausible before the 2026 deadline.
sources_consulted: Historical news on US interest in Greenland
Statements from Danish and Greenlandic governments
